title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十 仁宗二
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十 仁宗二 Volume 10 Annals 10: Renzong 2

sentences.zh: 明道元年春二月癸卯，呂夷簡上《三朝寶訓》。

translations.literal: Mingdao year one, spring, second month, day guimao: Lü Yijian presented the Precious Instructions of Three Reigns.
translations.idiomatic: Mingdao 1, second month, guimao: Lü Yijian submitted the Precious Instructions of Three Reigns.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔仕廣南者毋過兩任，以防貪黷。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, edict: those serving in far Guangnan were not to exceed two terms, to guard against greed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Guangnan posts were capped at two terms to curb corruption.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以張士遜同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士。

translations.literal: Day gengxu: Zhang Shixun was made co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhang Shixun became co-chancellor with Jixian grand academician rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，錄故宰臣孫，並試將作監主簿。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: descendants of former chief ministers were enrolled and tested as master clerks of the Directorate of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, former premiers’ heirs were tested for works-directorate posts.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔員外郎以上致仕者，錄其子校書郎，三丞以上齋郎。

translations.literal: Day jiazi, edict: outer-office officials of the fifth rank and above who retired were to enroll a son as collating secretary; from the third rank deputy up, a ritual attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, retiring fifth-rank officials could register a son as collating secretary; third-rank deputies and above, a ritual attendant.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以真宗順容李氏為宸妃，是日妃薨。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Zhenzong’s Gentle Countenance Lady Li was made Talented Consort; that day the consort died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Zhenzong’s Lady Li became Talented Consort—and died the same day.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，頒《天聖編敕》。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuzi: the Heavenly Sage Compiled Statutes were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wuzi: the Heavenly Sage Compiled Statutes were issued.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以江、淮旱，遣使與長吏錄系囚，流以下減一等，杖笞釋之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: because of drought in Jiang and Huai, envoys with local chiefs were to review prisoners; exile and below reduced one degree; beating and flogging released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Jiang-Huai drought sent judges to cut exile one grade and free flogging cases.

sentences.zh: 己亥，除婺、秀州丁身錢。

translations.literal: Day jihai: the head-tax money of Wu and Xiu prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wu and Xiu head taxes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙午，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingwu: prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，知棣州王涉坐冒請官地為職田，配廣南牢城。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Di prefecture prefect Wang She was banished to Guangnan prison for falsely claiming state land as an office field.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Di’s Wang She was sent to Guangnan prison for seizing state land as an office field.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，遣使點檢河北城池器甲，密訪官吏能否。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guiyou: envoys were sent to inspect Hebei city walls and armor and secretly inquire into officials’ competence.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guiyou: envoys inspected Hebei defenses and quietly rated officials.

sentences.zh: 壬午，廢杭、秀二州鹽場。

translations.literal: Day renwu: the salt depots of Hang and Xiu prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Hang and Xiu salt depots were closed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，詔諸路轉運使舉國子監講官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingshen, edict: transport commissioners on all circuits were to recommend lecturers for the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingshen: every transport commissioner was to nominate an imperial college lecturer.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王曙罷。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Wang Shu was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Wang Shu was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見，彌月乃滅。

translations.literal: Venus appeared by day and did not fade for a full month.
translations.idiomatic: Venus shone in daylight for an entire month.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以晏殊為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinchou: Yan Shu was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, xinchou: Yan Shu became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晏殊參知政事。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Yan Shu became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yan Shu joined the council.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以楊崇勳為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: Yang Chongxun was made vice military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Yang Chongxun became vice military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，授唃廝囉為甯遠大將軍、愛州團練使。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: Gusiluo was made great general of Pacifying the Far and regimental commander of Ai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Gusiluo received Pacifying-the-Far generalship and Ai command.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，大內火，延八殿。

translations.literal: Day renxu: fire in the inner palace spread through eight halls.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, inner-palace fire consumed eight halls.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，移御延福宮。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the court moved to Yanfu Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the court relocated to Yanfu Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以呂夷簡為修內使。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lü Yijian was made palace-repair commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lü Yijian took charge of palace repairs.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，詔群臣直言闕失。

translations.literal: Day yichou, edict: ministers were to speak frankly of omissions and faults.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, ministers were invited to report every fault plainly.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，重作受命寶。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the Mandate-receiving seal was remade.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengyin: the Mandate-receiving seal was recast.

sentences.zh: 丙申，皇太后出金銀器易左藏緡錢二十萬，以助修內。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: the empress dowager released gold and silver vessels to exchange for two hundred thousand strings of cash from the left treasury to aid repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the dowager sold palace gold and silver for two hundred thousand strings to fund repairs.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚子，黃白氣五貫紫微垣。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengzi: yellow-white vapor in five bands crossed the Purple Forbidden enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengzi: five bands of yellow-white mist crossed the Purple Forbidden stars.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔漢陽軍發廩粟以振饑民。

translations.literal: Day dingsi, edict: Hanyang army was to open granaries to relieve famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Hanyang was ordered to feed the hungry from state grain.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，以修內成，恭謝天地于天安殿，謁太廟，大赦，改元，百官進秩，優賞諸軍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiaxu: with repairs complete, Heaven and Earth were thanked in Tian’an Hall, the imperial temple visited, great amnesty proclaimed, the era name changed, officials advanced, and the armies richly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiaxu: repairs done, the court thanked Heaven and Earth, visited the temple, changed the era, amnestied, promoted ranks, and rewarded the armies.

sentences.zh: 是日還宮。

translations.literal: That day the palace was reoccupied.
translations.idiomatic: That day the court returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 己卯，冬至，率百官賀皇太后于文德殿，御天安殿受朝。

translations.literal: Day jimao: on the winter solstice the emperor led officials to congratulate the empress dowager at Wende Hall, then received court in Tian’an Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, winter solstice: he led the court to salute the dowager at Wende, then held audience in Tian’an.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，延州言夏王趙德明卒。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Yan prefecture reported that Xia King Zhao Deming had died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yanzhou reported Xia King Zhao Deming’s death.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以德明子元昊為定難軍節度使、西平王。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Deming’s son Yuanhao was made military commissioner of Dingnan and Prince of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Deming’s son Yuanhao received Dingnan command and the title Prince of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，以楊崇勳為樞密使。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renyin: Yang Chongxun was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renyin: Yang Chongxun became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔獲劫盜者奏裁，毋擅殺。

translations.literal: Day wuwu, edict: captured robbers were to be reported for decision; they were not to be killed on authority.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, bandits taken alive were to await imperial sentence—no summary execution.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，西北有蒼白氣亙天。

translations.literal: Day renxu: pale blue vapor stretched across the sky in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, pale blue mist arched the northwestern sky.

sentences.zh: 是歲，京東、淮南、江東饑。

translations.literal: That year, eastern Jing, Huainan, and Jiangdong suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck eastern Jing, Huainan, and Jiangdong.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己卯，詔發運使以上供米百萬斛振江、淮饑民，遣使督視。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jimao, edict: the transport commissioner was to release a million hu of tribute grain to relieve Jiang-Huai famine victims, with envoys to oversee.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, jimao: a million hu of tribute grain went to Jiang-Huai famine relief under imperial overseers.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，含譽星見東北方。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: the Honoring Worthy star appeared in the northeast.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuxu: the Honoring Worthy star appeared in the northeast.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔江、淮民饑死者，官為之葬祭。

translations.literal: Day gengzi, edict: where Jiang-Huai people died of famine, officials were to bury and sacrifice for them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Jiang-Huai famine dead were to receive official burial and rites.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，皇太后服袞衣、儀天冠饗太廟，皇太妃亞獻，皇后終獻。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the empress dowager wore dark robes and the Yitian crown to feast at the imperial temple; the imperial consort was secondary offerer; the empress final offerer.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the dowager in mourning dress and Yitian crown offered at the temple; the imperial consort assisted; the empress completed the rites.

sentences.zh: 是日，上皇太后尊號曰應元齊聖顯功崇德慈仁保壽皇太后。

translations.literal: That day the empress dowager was given the honorific Responding to the Primal, Equal in Holiness, Manifest Merit, Honored Virtue, Merciful Benevolence, Preserving Longevity.
translations.idiomatic: That day the dowager received the style Responding to the Primal through Preserving Longevity.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祀先農於東郊，躬耕籍田，大赦。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the spirit of the first agriculturist was sacrificed to at the eastern suburb; the emperor personally plowed the sacred field; great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, he sacrificed to the first farmer, plowed the sacred field, and proclaimed amnesty.

sentences.zh: 百官上尊號曰睿聖文武體天法道仁明孝德皇帝。

translations.literal: Officials offered the honorific Sagely, Civil and Military, Patterning Heaven and the Way, Benevolent, Bright, and Filial.
translations.idiomatic: The bureaucracy offered him Sagely, Civil and Military, Patterning Heaven and the Way, Benevolent, Bright, and Filial.

sentences.zh: 三月庚午，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Third month, day gengwu: officials received added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, gengwu: officials received extra favors.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，祈雨於會靈觀、上清宮、景德開寶寺。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: rain was prayed for at Huiling Abbey, Shangqing Palace, and Jingde-Kaibao Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, rain was sought at Huiling, Shangqing, and Jingde-Kaibao.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以皇太后不豫，大赦，除常赦所不原者。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: because the empress dowager was unwell, great amnesty—even what the regular amnesty did not spare.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the dowager’s illness brought amnesty beyond the usual limits.

sentences.zh: 乾興以來貶死者復官，謫者內徙。

translations.literal: Those demoted to death since Qianxing had offices restored; exiles were moved inward.
translations.idiomatic: Qianxing-era death sentences were reversed; exiles were recalled inland.

sentences.zh: 甲午，皇太后崩，遺詔尊皇太妃為皇太后。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the empress dowager died; her testament raised the imperial consort to empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the dowager died; her will made the imperial consort empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 呂夷簡為山陵使。

translations.literal: Lü Yijian was made mountain-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yijian became tomb commissioner.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙申朔，出大行皇太后遺留物賜近臣。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingshen new moon: the late empress dowager’s leftover goods were bestowed on close officials.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, new moon bingshen: the late dowager’s goods were given to intimates.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，追尊宸妃李氏為皇太后，至是帝始知為宸妃所生。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Talented Consort Li was posthumously honored as empress dowager; only then did the emperor learn she was his birth mother.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Lady Li was posthumously made empress dowager—and the emperor learned she was his mother.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以大行皇太后山陵五使並兼追尊皇太后園陵使。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: the five commissioners for the late empress dowager’s tomb were also made commissioners for the posthumous empress’s garden tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, the late dowager’s tomb commissioners also took charge of the new empress’s burial.

sentences.zh: 戊申，聽政於崇政殿西廂。

translations.literal: Day wushen: government was heard in the west wing of Chongde Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, he began hearing government in Chongde’s west wing.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷乾元節上壽。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: longevity wishes on the Qianyuan festival were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Qianyuan birthday salutations were ended.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔臣僚、宗戚、命婦毋得以進獻祈恩澤，及緣親戚通表章。

translations.literal: Day renzi, edict: ministers, kin, and titled ladies were not to present gifts seeking favor, nor use kinship to forward memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, officials and kin were forbidden to buy favor with gifts or kinship memorials.

sentences.zh: 罷創修寺觀。

translations.literal: New construction of temples and abbeys was halted.
translations.idiomatic: New temples and abbeys were banned.

sentences.zh: 帝始親政，裁抑僥倖，中外大悅。

translations.literal: The emperor began to rule in person, curbing favoritism; court and country rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Personal rule began; favoritism was cut—and court and country rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，召還宋綬、范仲淹。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Song Shou and Fan Zhongyan were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Song Shou and Fan Zhongyan returned to court.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，內侍江德明等並坐交通請謁黜。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: eunuchs Jiang Deming and others were all dismissed for trafficking in access and petitions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Jiang Deming and fellow eunuchs fell for selling access.

sentences.zh: 己未，呂夷簡、張耆、夏竦、陳堯佐、范雍、趙稹、晏殊皆罷。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: Lü Yijian, Zhang Qi, Xia Song, Chen Yaozuo, Fan Yong, Zhao Zhi, and Yan Shu were all removed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, Lü Yijian, Zhang Qi, Xia Song, Chen Yaozuo, Fan Yong, Zhao Zhi, and Yan Shu were swept out.

sentences.zh: 以張士遜為昭文館大學士，李迪同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，王隨參知政事，李諮為樞密副使，王德用簽書樞密院事。

translations.literal: Zhang Shixun was made grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall; Li Di co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery and grand academician of the Jixian Hall; Wang Sui participating administrator; Li Zi vice military affairs commissioner; Wang Deyong co-signer of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shixun took Zhaowen; Li Di became co-chancellor; Wang Sui joined the council; Li Zi and Wang Deyong took military posts.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御紫宸殿，以張士遜為山陵使兼園陵使。

translations.literal: Day renxu: from Zichen Hall, Zhang Shixun was made tomb and garden-tomb commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, from Zichen Hall, Zhang Shixun took both tomb commissions.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，上大行太后諡曰莊獻明肅，追尊宸妃李氏為皇太后，諡曰莊懿。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the late empress dowager was styled Bright Offering, Bright Solemn; Talented Consort Li was posthumously honored empress dowager with the style Bright Grace.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the late dowager became Bright Offering, Bright Solemn; Lady Li posthumously Bright Grace.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen, edict: the Ministry of Rites examination.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuchen: the Ministry of Rites examination was ordered.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔中外勿輒言皇太后垂簾日事。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: within and without the court, do not casually speak of the empress dowager’s curtain days.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, talk of the regency years was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，罷群牧制置使。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the herd-management commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the herd commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙子，命宰臣張士遜撰《謝太廟》及《躬耕籍田記》。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: chief ministers were ordered to compose “Thanking the Imperial Temple” and “Personal Ploughing of the Sacred Field.”
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Zhang Shixun was told to write temple thanks and sacred-field memoirs.

sentences.zh: 檢討宋祁言，皇太后謁廟非後世法，乃止撰《籍田記》。

translations.literal: Reviewer Song Qi said the empress dowager’s temple visit was not a later-age rite; only the sacred-field memoir was written.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qi argued the dowager’s temple visit broke precedent; only the field memoir was drafted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 六月甲午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiawu new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, new moon jiawu: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，錄周世宗及高季興、李煜、孟昶、劉繼元、劉鋹後。

translations.literal: Day renyin: descendants of Later Zhou’s Shizong and of Gao Jixing, Li Yu, Meng Chang, Liu Jiyuan, and Liu Chang were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, heirs of Shizong, Gao Jixing, Li Yu, Meng Chang, and the Liu houses were registered.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命審刑、大理詳定配隸刑名。

translations.literal: Day guimao: the Court of Judicial Review and Court of Appeals were ordered to fix assigned exile penalties.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, judicial review fixed exile sentences.

sentences.zh: 戊午，減天下歲貢物。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: annual tribute goods empire-wide were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, empire-wide tribute was cut.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，詔知耀州富平縣事張龜年增秩再任，以其治行風告天下。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingchou, edict: Zhang Guinian, acting magistrate of Fuping county, Yao prefecture, was advanced in rank for a second term because his governance was proclaimed as a model to the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingchou: Fuping’s Zhang Guinian was promoted and kept for a model administration.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔以蝗旱，去尊號「睿聖文武」四字，以告天地宗廟，仍令中外直言闕政。

translations.literal: Day wuzi, edict: because of locusts and drought, the four characters “Sagely, Civil and Military” were removed from the honorific; Heaven, Earth, and the temple were told; within and without, frank counsel on faults was sought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, locust and drought stripped “Sagely, Civil and Military” from his title and called for blunt reform memorials.

sentences.zh: 八月甲午朔，契丹使來吊慰祭奠。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiawu new moon: Khitan envoys came to mourn and console.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon jiawu: Khitan envoys came to mourn.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，作奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Offering Grace Temple was built.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Offering Grace Temple was raised.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔中外毋避莊獻明肅太后父諱。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: within and without, do not avoid the late empress dowager’s father’s name.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, taboo on the late dowager’s father’s name was lifted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，置端明殿學士。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: the awaiting appointment of the Brilliant Illumination Hall was established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Brilliant Illumination Hall awaiting appointment was instituted.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，幸洪福院，臨莊懿太后梓宮。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: Hongfu Court was visited; the late Bright Grace empress dowager’s coffin was attended.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiaxu: he attended Bright Grace’s coffin at Hongfu Court.

sentences.zh: 丙子、壬午，臨如之。

translations.literal: Days bingzi and renwu: he attended again as before.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi and renwu he returned to the bier.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸巳朔，太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day guisi new moon: Venus trespassed on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon guisi: Venus crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲午，禁登州民採金。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Deng prefecture people were forbidden to mine gold.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, gold mining at Deng was banned.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，祔葬莊獻明肅皇太后、莊懿皇太后于永定陵。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the Bright Offering, Bright Solemn empress dowager and Bright Grace empress dowager were buried with Yongding tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, both dowagers were buried at Yongding.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔以兩川歲貢綾錦羅綺紗，以三之二易為糸由絹，供軍須。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, edict: of the two circuits’ annual tribute of damask, brocade, gauze, and silk, two-thirds were to be exchanged for raw silk and plain silk for army needs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, two-thirds of Sichuan’s silk tribute was to be taken in raw silk for the armies.

sentences.zh: 己酉，祔莊獻明肅太后、莊懿太后神主于奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: both empresses’ spirit tablets were enshrined in Offering Grace Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, both empresses entered Offering Grace Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，下德音，降東、西京囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day guichou: a lenient edict reduced eastern and western capital crimes one degree; penal servitude and below released.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, both capitals won one-grade relief and release below penal servitude.

sentences.zh: 緣二太后陵應奉民戶，免租賦科役有差。

translations.literal: Households serving the two empresses’ tombs were exempted from rent and corvée by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Tomb-service households for both empresses received graded tax and labor relief.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，贈周王祐為皇太子。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Prince of Zhou You was posthumously made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Prince of Zhou You was posthumously made heir.

sentences.zh: 戊午，張士遜、楊崇勳罷，以呂夷簡為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，王曙為樞密使，王德用為樞密副使，宋綬參知政事，蔡齊為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Zhang Shixun and Yang Chongxun were removed; Lü Yijian was made vice director of the Chancellery, co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and Zhaowen grand academician; Wang Shu military affairs commissioner; Wang Deyong vice commissioner; Song Shou participating administrator; Cai Qi vice commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Zhang and Yang fell; Lü Yijian returned as chancellor; Wang Shu and Wang Deyong took military affairs; Song Shou and Cai Qi joined the council.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥朔，薛奎罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guihai new moon: Xue Kui was removed.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon guihai: Xue Kui was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 詔增宗室奉。

translations.literal: Edict: stipends for the imperial clan were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clan stipends were raised.

sentences.zh: 太白犯南斗。

translations.literal: Venus trespassed on the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: Venus again crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，追冊美人張氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Lady Zhang the Fair was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the late Fair Lady Zhang was made empress.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，贈寇准為中書令。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Kou Zhun was posthumously made director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Kou Zhun was posthumously made Secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，復置提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingshen: punishment intendants on all circuits were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingshen: circuit punishment intendants were restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔諸路轉運使、副，歲遍曆所部，仍令州軍具所至月日以聞。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: transport commissioners and deputies were each year to tour their circuits and have prefectures report arrival months and days.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, transport chiefs were to tour annually with dated arrival reports from every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以京東饑，出內藏絹二十萬代其民歲輸。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: because of famine in eastern Jing, two hundred thousand bolts of palace silk were released in place of the people’s annual delivery.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, eastern Jing famine won two hundred thousand bolts of palace silk in lieu of local tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔修周廟。

translations.literal: Day yisi: edict to restore the Zhou temples.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the court ordered the Zhou temples restored.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔台官非中丞、知雜保薦者勿任。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: edict that memorial-drafters not nominated by the censor-in-chief or supervising auxiliary bureau chief should not be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, censorial draftsmen needed endorsement from the chief censor or supervising aide before they could serve.

sentences.zh: 戊申，出宮人二百。

translations.literal: Day wushen: two hundred palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, two hundred palace women were sent out of the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，廢皇后郭氏為淨妃、玉京沖妙仙師，居長寧宮。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Empress Guo was deposed as Pure Consort and Jade Capital Transcendent Wonder Immortal Master, dwelling at Everlasting Peace Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, Empress Guo was stripped of her title, made Pure Consort and Jade Capital Transcendent Wonder Immortal Master, and sent to Everlasting Peace Palace.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞孔道輔率諫官、御史，大呼殿門請對，詔宰相告以皇后當廢狀。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Kong Daofu led remonstrance officials and censors to shout at the palace gate and request audience; the emperor ordered the chief ministers to explain the grounds for deposing the empress.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Kong Daofu and his remonstrance colleagues clamored at the palace gate for an audience; the emperor had the chief ministers explain why the empress must go.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，出道輔及諫官范仲淹，仍詔台諫自今毋相率請對。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Kong Daofu and remonstrance official Fan Zhongyan were sent out; an edict also forbade censors and remonstrators from acting in concert to request audience from now on.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Kong Daofu and Fan Zhongyan were banished from court, and censors were forbidden to storm the gate in concert again.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔明年改元。

translations.literal: Day dingsi: edict that the era name would be changed next year.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the court announced a new reign title for the coming year.

sentences.zh: 禁邊臣增置堡砦。

translations.literal: Frontier officials were forbidden to add forts and stockades on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Border commanders were barred from building new forts without leave.

sentences.zh: 是歲，畿內、京東西、河北、河東、陝西蝗，淮南、江東、兩川饑，遣使安撫，除民租。

translations.literal: That year, locusts struck the capital region, eastern and western Jing, Hebei, Hedong, and Shaanxi; Huainan, Jiangdong, and the two Sichuan circuits suffered famine; envoys were sent to comfort, and the people’s rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts ravaged the heartland and north; Huainan, Jiangdong, and Sichuan starved—comfort envoys went out and rents were cut.

sentences.zh: 注輦國來貢。

translations.literal: The Chola state came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Chola sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年春正月甲子，發江、淮漕米振京東饑民。

translations.literal: Jingyou year one, spring, first month, day jiazi: Jiang-Huai transport grain was sent to relieve famine in eastern Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyou 1, first month, jiazi: grain from the Jiang-Huai canal fed eastern Jing’s hungry.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔開封府界諸縣作糜粥以濟饑民，諸災傷州軍亦如之。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: edict that counties in the Kaifeng prefecture circuit should make gruel porridge to aid famine victims, and disaster-struck prefectures and armies likewise.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, Kaifeng circuit counties were told to set up gruel kitchens; other disaster counties were to do the same.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔三司鑄景祐元寶錢。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: edict that the Three Departments mint Jingyou yuanbao coins.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the Three Departments were ordered to cast Jingyou yuanbao cash.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔執政大臣議兵農可更制者以聞。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: edict that chief ministers report on military and agricultural reforms worth adopting.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the chief ministers were asked to propose reforms in arms and agriculture.

sentences.zh: 詔募民掘蝗種，給菽米。

translations.literal: Edict to recruit the people to dig up locust eggs, granting beans and grain.
translations.idiomatic: The people were paid in grain and beans to dig up locust eggs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔禮部所試舉人十取其二，進士三舉、諸科五舉嘗經殿試，進士五舉年五十、諸科六舉年六十，及曾經先朝御試者，皆以名聞。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: edict that in the Ministry of Rites examinations two of ten candidates pass; jinshi with three attempts, miscellaneous subjects with five who had sat the palace examination, jinshi with five attempts at age fifty, miscellaneous subjects with six at age sixty, and those who had sat the former emperor’s palace examination—all were to be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the civil exams took two in ten; veterans of palace exams, repeaters of a certain age, and those tested under the late emperor were all to be named to the throne.

sentences.zh: 甲申，淮南饑，出內藏絹二十萬代其民歲輸。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: because of famine in Huainan, two hundred thousand bolts of palace silk were issued in place of the people’s annual tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Huainan’s famine brought two hundred thousand bolts of palace silk in lieu of annual tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，置崇政殿說書。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: lecturers were established at the Hall of Esteeming Learning.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Hall of Esteeming Learning gained court lecturers.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔停淮南上供一年。

translations.literal: Day gengyin: edict to suspend Huainan’s annual tribute for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Huainan’s tribute to the court was halted for a year.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，罷書判拔萃科。

translations.literal: Second month, day yiwei: the Written Judgment and Outstanding Talent examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, yiwei: the Written Judgment and Outstanding Talent exam was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔禮部貢院：諸科舉人七舉者，不限年，並許特奏名。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: edict to the Ministry of Rites examination hall: candidates in miscellaneous subjects with seven attempts, regardless of age, were all permitted special presentation by name.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, miscellaneous examinees who had failed seven times could be specially presented regardless of age.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，權減江、淮漕米二百萬石。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: Jiang-Huai transport grain was provisionally reduced by two million shi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Jiang-Huai canal shipments were cut by two million shi.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔麟、府州振蕃、漢饑民。

translations.literal: Day wushen: edict to relieve famine among Tangut and Han in Lin and Fu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Lin and Fu were ordered to feed Tangut and Han famine victims.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午，免諸路災傷州軍今年夏稅。

translations.literal: Third month, day renwu: this year’s summer tax was remitted in disaster-struck prefectures and armies on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, renwu: summer tax was waived in disaster counties on every circuit.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔解州畦戶逋鹽蠲其半。

translations.literal: Day guiwei: edict that half the overdue salt owed by Jiezhou saltern households be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, Jiezhou saltern households had half their salt arrears written off.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身七百八十三人。

translations.literal: That month, seven hundred eighty-three jinshi and miscellaneous subjects who passed the Ministry of Rites list were granted rank.
translations.idiomatic: That month, seven hundred eighty-three men passed the palace list and received rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，開封府判官龐籍言，尚美人遣內侍稱教旨免工人市租。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day dingyou: Kaifeng prefecture judge Pang Ji reported that Lady Shang had sent a eunuch claiming an imperial order to exempt workers from market rent.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, dingyou: judge Pang Ji reported that Lady Shang’s eunuch had forged an order waiving market rent for artisans.

sentences.zh: 帝為杖內侍，仍詔有司自今宮中傳命，毋得輒受。

translations.literal: The emperor had the eunuch beaten with the staff and also edicted that from now on offices must not accept palace messages on their own.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had the eunuch flogged and forbade agencies to heed palace messages without verification.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔置殿中侍御史、監察御史裏行。

translations.literal: Day guichou: edict to establish acting palace censors and surveillance censors.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, acting palace and surveillance censors were created.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，出布十萬端，易錢糴河北軍儲。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day xinyou: one hundred thousand bolts of cloth were issued to buy grain and fill Hebei army stores.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, xinyou: one hundred thousand bolts of cloth bought grain for Hebei granaries.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，禁民間織錦刺繡為服飾。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the people were forbidden to weave brocade and embroidery for clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, commoners were barred from brocade and embroidered dress.

sentences.zh: 西川歲織錦上供亦罷之。

translations.literal: Western Sichuan’s annual tribute brocade was also abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Western Sichuan’s annual tribute brocade was ended as well.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔台諫未曾曆郡守者與郡。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: edict that censors and remonstrators who had not served as prefectural administrators be given prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, censors without prefectural experience were sent to govern counties.

sentences.zh: 壬午，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day renwu: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 是月，契丹主宗真之母還政於子，出居慶陵。

translations.literal: That month, the Khitan ruler Zongzhen’s mother returned government to her son and retired to Qing tomb.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Khitan emperor’s mother handed rule back to Zongzhen and withdrew to Qing tomb.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，交州民六百餘人內附。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renchen: more than six hundred people of Jiaozhou submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renchen: over six hundred Jiaozhou families came in.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免畿內被災民稅之半。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: half the tax of disaster victims in the capital region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, capital-region disaster victims paid half tax.

sentences.zh: 己酉，策制舉、武舉人。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: decree-examination and military-examination candidates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, decree and military examinees sat their tests.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔州縣官非理科決罪人至死者，並奏聽裁。

translations.literal: Day yimao: edict that prefectural and county officials who without statutory authority judged criminals to death must all memorialize for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, local officials who sentenced anyone to death without proper authority had to seek imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子，泗州淮、汴溢。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day jiazi: the Huai and Bian rivers overflowed at Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, jiazi: the Huai and Bian flooded Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，常州無錫縣大風髮屋。

translations.literal: Day jisi: a great wind in Wuxi county, Changzhou, tore off roofs.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, a gale in Wuxi, Changzhou, stripped roofs from houses.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，毀天下無額寺院。

translations.literal: Day yihai: unlicensed temples throughout the realm were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, unregistered temples across the empire were torn down.

sentences.zh: 壬午，罷造玳瑁、龜筒器。

translations.literal: Day renwu: manufacture of tortoiseshell and hawksbill vessels was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, tortoiseshell and hawksbill ware was banned.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙申，賜壽州下蔡縣被溺之家錢有差。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day bingshen: money was given in graded amounts to drowned households in Xiaocai county, Shouzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, bingshen: Shouzhou’s Xiaocai county paid graded relief to flood victims.

sentences.zh: 己亥，樞密使王曙加同平章事。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Shu was made concurrent associate chief councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Wang Shu of the Military Affairs Bureau became associate chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔文武提刑毋得互相薦論。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: edict that civil and military judicial commissioners must not recommend one another.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, civil and military judicial commissioners were forbidden to cross-nominate.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔轉運使與長吏，舉所部官專領常平倉粟。

translations.literal: Day renzi: edict that transport commissioners and chief prefectural administrators recommend officials in their jurisdictions to manage Ever-Normal granary grain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, transport commissioners and prefects were to name officials to run Ever-Normal granaries.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，河決澶州橫隴埽。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Yellow River broke through at Henglong embankment in Cao prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Yellow River burst Henglong embankment in Cao prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，薛奎卒。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengshen: Xue Kui died.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengshen: the minister Xue Kui died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，有星孛于張、翼。

translations.literal: Day renxu: a comet appeared in the Wings and the Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, a comet blazed in the Wings and the Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，王曙卒。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Wang Shu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Shu died.

sentences.zh: 甲子，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the moon crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝不豫。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: the emperor was unwell.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the emperor fell ill.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以王曾為樞密使。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Wang Zeng was made military affairs commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Wang Zeng became military affairs commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以星變，大赦，避正殿，減常膳，輔臣奏事延和殿閣。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: because of the stellar anomaly, a great amnesty was proclaimed; the emperor avoided the main hall, reduced his regular meals, and chief ministers reported affairs in the Yanhe Hall gallery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the comet brought a great amnesty: the emperor left the main hall, ate sparingly, and ministers met him in the Yanhe gallery.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔淨妃郭氏出居於外，美人尚氏入道，楊氏安置別宅。

translations.literal: Day renshen: edict that Pure Consort Guo dwell outside, Lady Shang enter the Way, and Lady Yang be lodged in a separate residence.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, Pure Consort Guo was sent out, Lady Shang took the tonsure, and Lady Yang was housed apart.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，百官請只日御前殿，如先帝故事，詔可。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renchen: the hundred officials requested that on alternate days he hold court in the front hall as under the former emperor; the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renchen: officials asked for alternate-day audiences in the front hall as of old; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，帝康復，御正殿，復常膳。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: the emperor recovered; he held court in the main hall and restored his regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the emperor recovered, returned to the main hall, and ate as before.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔立皇后曹氏。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: edict to install Lady Cao as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Lady Cao was named empress.

sentences.zh: 丙午，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Mars crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚申，罷淮南、江、浙、荊湖制置發運使，詔淮南轉運兼發運事。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day gengshen: the Huainan, Jiang-Zhe, and Jing-Hu supervisory transport commissioners were abolished; edict that the Huainan transport commissioner also handle transport affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengshen: Huainan, Jiang-Zhe, and Jing-Hu transport superintendents were abolished; Huainan’s transport commissioner took over their duties.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，作郊廟《景安》、《興安》、《祐安》之曲。

translations.literal: Day yihai: suburban and temple melodies Jing An, Xing An, and You An were composed.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the court composed Jing An, Xing An, and You An for suburban rites.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑，冊曹氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jichou: Lady Cao was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jichou: Lady Cao was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，作《大安》之曲以饗聖祖。

translations.literal: Day guichou: the melody Great Peace was composed to feast the Sagely Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the hymn Great Peace was written for the Sagely Ancestor’s feast.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸酉，賜西平王趙元昊佛經。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiyou: Buddhist scriptures were bestowed on Western Pacification King Zhao Yuanhao.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiyou: Yuanhao of Western Pacification received Buddhist scriptures.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南平王李德政獻馴象二，詔還之。

translations.literal: That year, Southern Pacification King Li Dezheng presented two tame elephants; edict to return them.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Dezheng of Southern Pacification sent two tame elephants; the court sent them back.

sentences.zh: 開封府、淄州蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts struck Kaifeng prefecture and Zibo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts ravaged Kaifeng and Zibo.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸丑，置邇英、延義二閣，寫《尚書•無逸》篇於屏。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day guichou: the Approaching Excellence and Extending Righteousness pavilions were established; the “No Dissipation” chapter of the Documents was written on their screens.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, guichou: Approaching Excellence and Extending Righteousness pavilions rose, their screens inscribed with “No Dissipation” from the Documents.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，御延福宮觀大樂。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuwu: he visited Extended Blessings Palace to view the great music.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, wuwu: he watched the great orchestra at Extended Blessings Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，舊給事資善堂者皆推恩。

translations.literal: Day guihai: all who had formerly served at the Hall of Cultivating Goodness received extended favor.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, former tutors of the Hall of Cultivating Goodness were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，李迪罷，以王曾為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，王隨、李諮知樞密院事，蔡齊、盛度參知政事，王德用、韓億同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Li Di was removed; Wang Zeng was made vice director of the Secretariat, associate chief councilor, and grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies; Wang Sui and Li Zi became directors of the Military Affairs Bureau; Cai Qi and Sheng Du became participating administrators; Wang Deyong and Han Yi became associate directors of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Li Di fell; Wang Zeng became chancellor and Jixian grand academician; Wang Sui and Li Zi ran the Military Affairs Bureau; Cai Qi and Sheng Du joined the council; Wang Deyong and Han Yi became deputy directors.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，出內庫珠賜三司，以助經費。

translations.literal: Third month, day wushen: palace pearls were issued to the Three Departments to aid expenses.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, wushen: palace pearls went to the Three Departments to ease the treasury.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，詔天下有知樂者，所在薦聞。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day gengwu: edict that those throughout the realm who understood music be recommended wherever found.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, gengwu: the court sought musicians wherever they could be found.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，徭、獠寇雷、化州，詔桂、廣會兵討之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: Yao and Liao raided Lei and Hua prefectures; edict that Gui and Guang circuits join forces to suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, jiawu: Yao and Liao raided Lei and Hua; Gui and Guang were ordered to strike together.

sentences.zh: 丙申，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 庚子，議太祖、太宗、真宗廟並萬世不遷。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: deliberation that the temples of Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong would never be moved for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, the court ruled Taizu, Taizong, and Zhenzong would remain forever in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 南郊升侑上帝，以太祖定配，二宗迭配。

translations.literal: At the southern suburban altar the High God was elevated in association; Taizu was fixed as chief associate; the two emperors alternated as secondary associates.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern altar the High God was exalted; Taizu was fixed as chief partner and the two later emperors alternated.

sentences.zh: 丙午，降天下系囚罪一等，杖以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: crimes of prisoners throughout the realm were reduced one degree; those below the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, prisoners empire-wide were cut one grade; flogging cases were freed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，廣西言鎮寧州蠻入寇。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Guangxi reported that barbarians of Zhenning prefecture had entered to raid.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Guangxi reported Zhenning barbarians raiding.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳，詔幕職官初任未成考毋薦。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day dingsi: edict that staff officials in first appointment who had not completed review should not be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, dingsi: junior staff without a completed review could not be nominated.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，頒《一司一務及在京敕》。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the One Office One Service and Capital Edicts were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the One Office One Service and Capital Edicts were issued.

sentences.zh: 鎮寧蠻請降。

translations.literal: The Zhenning barbarians requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenning tribes asked to submit.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，廢西京采柴務，以山林賦民，官取十之一。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wushen: the Western Capital firewood-gathering office was abolished; mountain forests were assigned to the people, the government taking one-tenth.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, wushen: the Western Capital timber office closed; forests went to commoners with a ten-percent levy to the state.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，詔輕強盜法。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day renzi new moon: edict to lighten the law on armed robbery.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, new moon renzi: armed robbery was punished less harshly.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宴紫宸殿，初用樂。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: a feast was held in Purple Reach Hall; music was used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Purple Reach Hall feasted with music for the first time.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，幸安肅門炮場閱習戰。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: he visited the drill ground at Peaceful Solemn Gate to review battle practice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he watched maneuvers at Peaceful Solemn Gate’s drill field.

sentences.zh: 己卯，置提點銀銅坑冶鑄錢官。

translations.literal: Day jimao: officials to supervise silver, copper, mining, smelting, and coin-casting were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, inspectors were named for mines, smelters, and mints.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，按新樂。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: the new music was rehearsed.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: the new court music was rehearsed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，作睦親宅。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Harmonious Kin mansion was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the Harmonious Kin mansion was built for the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 命中丞杜衍等汰三司胥吏。

translations.literal: Vice censor-in-chief Du Yan and others were ordered to weed out Three Departments clerks.
translations.idiomatic: Du Yan and fellow censors were told to purge Three Departments clerks.

sentences.zh: 宋綬上《中書總例》。

translations.literal: Song Shou presented the General Regulations of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Song Shou submitted the Secretariat’s General Regulations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，復置朝集院。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day xinhai new moon: the Court Assembly Institute was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, new moon xinhai: the Court Assembly Institute was restored.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，復群牧制置使。

translations.literal: Day guihai: the Herd Office supervisory commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the Herd Office superintendent was restored.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔諸路歲輸緡錢，福建、二廣易以銀，江東以帛。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: edict that on all circuits annual tribute of cash strings—Fujian and the two Guang circuits pay in silver, Jiangdong in silk.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, annual cash tribute was reformed: Fujian and Guang paid silver, Jiangdong paid silk.

sentences.zh: 庚午，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Mars transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, Mars crossed the Left Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，廢後郭氏薨。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuzi: deposed Empress Guo died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuzi: the deposed Empress Guo died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，朝饗景靈宮。

translations.literal: Day guisi: morning feast at Meritorious Spirit Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, morning offerings were made at Meritorious Spirit Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，饗太廟、奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the ancestral temple and Cherishing Kindness temple were feasted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the imperial ancestors were feasted at the ancestral and Cherishing Kindness temples.

sentences.zh: 乙未，祀天地於圜丘，大赦。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the round altar and the realm was amnestied.

sentences.zh: 錄五代及諸國後。

translations.literal: Descendants of the Five Dynasties and the various states were enrolled.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Five Dynasties and former kingdoms were registered for office.

sentences.zh: 宗室任諸司使以下至殿直者，換西班官。

translations.literal: Clan members serving as commissioners of various offices down to palace attendants were transferred to western-banquet offices.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansmen in commissioner posts down to palace attendant were shifted to western-banquet ranks.

sentences.zh: 百官上尊號曰景祐體天法道欽文聰武聖神孝德皇帝。

translations.literal: Officials offered the honorific Jingyou, Patterning Heaven and the Way, Revering Culture and Sagacious Martiality, Sagely Spirit and Filial Virtue Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The court styled him Jingyou, Patterning Heaven and the Way, Revering Culture and Sagacious Martiality, Sagely Spirit and Filial Virtue Emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，加恩百官。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: added favors were bestowed on officials.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, officials received added rank grades.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，加唃廝囉為保順軍留後。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renzi: Gusiluo was advanced to acting military commissioner of Baoshun army.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renzi: Gusiluo became acting commissioner of Baoshun army.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔長吏能導民修水利辟荒田者賞之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: edict that chief administrators who could guide the people to repair waterworks and open wasteland be rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, prefects who led irrigation and land reclamation were promised rewards.

sentences.zh: 是歲，以鎮戎軍薦饑，貸弓箭手粟麥六萬石。

translations.literal: That year, because of famine at Zhenrong army, sixty thousand shi of grain and wheat were loaned to archer households.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhenrong’s famine brought sixty thousand shi of grain on loan to bowmen.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月壬辰，追復郭氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day renchen: Lady Guo was posthumously restored as empress.
translations.idiomatic: Year three, first month, renchen: the deposed Empress Guo was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，葬皇后郭氏。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Empress Guo was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Empress Guo was buried.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，命官較太常鐘律。

translations.literal: Second month, day bingchen: officials were ordered to compare the pitch pipes of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingchen: the court ordered a review of the ritual pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔兩制、禮官詳定京師士民服用、居室之制。

translations.literal: Day renxu: edict that drafters of two departments and ritual officials detail regulations for dress and dwellings of capital gentry and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, drafters and ritualists were told to fix dress and housing rules for Kaifeng’s elite and commoners.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以廣南兵民苦瘴毒，為置醫藥。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: because soldiers and people of Guangnan suffered miasma, medicine was provided for them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, medicine was sent to Guangnan troops and civilians stricken by miasma.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，修陝西三白渠。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: the Three White canals of Shaanxi were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Shaanxi’s Three White canals were repaired.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，復商賈以見錢算請官茶法。

translations.literal: Third month, day guisi: the merchant tea law requiring cash to purchase official tea was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guisi: merchants again had to buy official tea with cash.

sentences.zh: 乙未，觀新定鐘律。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the newly fixed pitch pipes were inspected.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the court inspected the newly tuned pitch pipes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔兩省、卿監、刺史、閣門以上致仕，給奉如分司官，長吏歲時勞賜之。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: edict that retired officials of the two departments, directorates, censors, and gatekeepers and above receive salaries like detached-service officials, and chief administrators give seasonal gifts and rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, high retirees were paid like detached-service officials and local chiefs were to visit them with seasonal gifts.

sentences.zh: 改維州為威州。

translations.literal: Wei prefecture was renamed Prestige prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The border prefecture of Wei was retitled Prestige.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚辰，購求館閣逸書。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day gengchen: lost books of the palace library were sought for purchase.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengchen: the court bought missing palace library books.

sentences.zh: 丙申，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day bingshen: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，天章閣待制范仲淹坐譏刺大臣，落職知饒州。

translations.literal: Day bingxu: Hanlin academician awaiting appointment Fan Zhongyan, for satirizing chief ministers, was demoted to prefect of Raozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Fan Zhongyan was banished to Raozhou for lampooning the chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 集賢校理余靖、館閣校勘尹洙、歐陽修並落職補外。

translations.literal: Collegium collator Yu Jing, academy collator Yin Zhu, and Ouyang Xiu were all demoted and sent out on provincial appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Jing, Yin Zhu, and Ouyang Xiu were demoted and sent to provincial posts.

sentences.zh: 詔戒百官越職言事。

translations.literal: Edict warning the hundred officials against overstepping their offices in memorializing.
translations.idiomatic: Officials were warned not to speak outside their proper duties.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，虔、吉州水溢，壞城郭、廬舍，賜被溺家錢有差。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Qian and Ji prefectures flooded, destroying walls and houses; money was given in graded amounts to drowned households.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renshen: floods wrecked Qian and Ji; drowned families received graded relief payments.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，禁民間私寫編敕、刑書。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dinghai: the people were forbidden to copy the compiled statutes and penal codes privately.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dinghai: private copying of statutes and penal codes was banned.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置大宗正司。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Great Clan Rectification office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Great Clan Rectification office was established.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大雨震電。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: great rain and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, thunderstorms broke over the capital.

sentences.zh: 太平興國寺災。

translations.literal: Great Peace Prosperity monastery burned.
translations.idiomatic: Great Peace Prosperity monastery burned down.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，降三京罪囚一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: crimes of prisoners in the three capitals were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, the three capitals cut prisoners one grade; penal-servitude cases were freed.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，班民間冠服、居室、車馬、器用犯制之禁。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: prohibitions on commoners’ caps, dress, dwellings, carriages, horses, and utensils that violated regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiyou: sumptuary rules for dress, housing, and transport were posted for commoners.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，月犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the moon crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 九月庚辰，幸睦親宅宴宗室。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengchen: he visited the Harmonious Kin mansion to feast the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, gengchen: he feasted the clan at the Harmonious Kin mansion.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Mars crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 是月，定申心喪解官法。

translations.literal: That month, the law on taking office after a mother’s heart-mourning was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court fixed rules for leaving office to mourn one’s mother.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，命章得象等考課諸路提刑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingwei: Zhang Dexiang and others were ordered to evaluate judicial commissioners on all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, dingwei: Zhang Dexiang and others were sent to grade circuit judicial commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，作朝集院。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: the Court Assembly Institute was built.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, the Court Assembly Institute was built.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，保慶皇太后楊氏崩。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuyin: Empress Dowager Yang of Protecting Celebration died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, wuyin: Protecting Celebration Empress Dowager Yang died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，上保慶太后諡曰莊惠。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the late Protecting Celebration empress dowager was given the posthumous title Sagely Kindness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Yang was posthumously titled Sagely Kindness.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，李諮卒。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day bingyin: Li Zi died.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, bingyin: Li Zi died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，王德用知樞密院事，章得象同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Wang Deyong became director of the Military Affairs Bureau; Zhang Dexiang became associate director.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Wang Deyong directed the Military Affairs Bureau and Zhang Dexiang became his deputy.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南平王李德政、西南蕃來貢。

translations.literal: That year, Southern Pacification King Li Dezheng and southwestern tribes came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Dezheng and southwestern tribes sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 南丹州莫淮戟內附。

translations.literal: Mo Huaizhan of Nandan prefecture submitted inward.
translations.idiomatic: Mo Huaizhan of Nandan came in.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬午，詔均諸州解額。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day renwu: edict to equalize examination quotas among prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Year four, first month, renwu: prefectural civil-exam quotas were equalized.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，葬莊惠皇太后于永定陵。

translations.literal: Second month, day jiyou: Empress Dowager Sagely Kindness was buried at Everlasting Stability tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jiyou: Sagely Kindness was buried at Everlasting Stability tomb.

sentences.zh: 己未，祔神主於奉慈廟。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: her spirit tablet was enshrined at Cherishing Kindness temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, her tablet entered Cherishing Kindness temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，德音：降東、西京及靈駕所過州縣囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day gengshen: merciful edict: crimes of prisoners in the eastern and western capitals and counties the imperial procession passed were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, eastern and western capitals and counties along the funeral route cut prisoners one grade and freed penal-servitude cases.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，置赤帝像于宮中祈嗣。

translations.literal: Day yichou: an image of the Red Emperor was installed in the palace to pray for an heir.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, a Red Emperor image was set up in the palace to pray for a son.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，置天章閣侍講。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiaxu: Heavenly Writings Pavilion lecturers were established.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiaxu: Heavenly Writings Pavilion gained court lecturers.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔禮部貢舉。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: edict for the Ministry of Rites civil examination.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Ministry of Rites civil exams were ordered.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，呂夷簡上《景祐法寶新錄》。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day yisi: Lü Yijian presented the Jingyou Treasured Laws New Record.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, yisi: Lü Yijian submitted the Jingyou Treasured Laws New Record.

sentences.zh: 甲子，呂夷簡、王曾、宋綬、蔡齊罷，以王隨為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，陳堯佐同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，盛度知樞密院事，韓億、程琳、石中立參知政事，王鬷同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day jiazi: Lü Yijian, Wang Zeng, Song Shou, and Cai Qi were removed; Wang Sui was made vice director of the Secretariat, associate chief councilor, and Zhaowen grand academician; Chen Yaozuo was made associate chief councilor and Jixian grand academician; Sheng Du became director of the Military Affairs Bureau; Han Yi, Cheng Lin, and Shi Zhongli became participating administrators; Wang Zou became associate director of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, Lü Yijian, Wang Zeng, Song Shou, and Cai Qi fell; Wang Sui and Chen Yaozuo became chancellors; Sheng Du ran the Military Affairs Bureau; Han Yi, Cheng Lin, and Shi Zhongli joined the council; Wang Zou became deputy director.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，皇子生，錄系囚，降死罪一等，流以下釋之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day gengxu: a prince was born; prisoners were reviewed; capital crimes were reduced one degree; those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, gengxu: a prince was born and prisoners were amnestied—capital sentences cut one grade, exile cases freed.

sentences.zh: 是日，皇子薨。

translations.literal: That day, the prince died.
translations.idiomatic: The newborn prince died the same day.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以旱，遣使決三京系囚。

translations.literal: Day yimao: because of drought, envoys were sent to decide cases of prisoners in the three capitals.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, drought sent envoys to judge prisoners in the three capitals.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，芝生化成殿楹。

translations.literal: Day bingyin: spirit fungus grew on the pillars of the Hall of Accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, auspicious fungus sprouted on the Hall of Accomplishment’s pillars.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，杭州江潮壞堤，遣使致祭。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Hangzhou’s tidal bore broke the dikes; envoys were sent to offer sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai: Hangzhou’s tide broke the dikes; the court sent sacrifice envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊子，出《神武秘略》賜邊臣。

translations.literal: Day wuzi: the Secret Martial Essentials was issued to frontier officials.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, frontier commanders received the Secret Martial Essentials.

sentences.zh: 己丑，奉安太祖御容于揚州建隆寺。

translations.literal: Day jichou: Taizu’s imperial portrait was installed at Jianlong monastery in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Taizu’s portrait was enshrined at Jianlong monastery in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，詔河東、河北州郡密嚴邊備。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingwei: edict that Hedong and Hebei prefectures and armies strictly prepare frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingwei: Hedong and Hebei were told to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 戊申，有星數百西南流至壁東，大者其光燭地，黑氣長丈余，出畢宿下。

translations.literal: Day wushen: several hundred stars flowed from the southwest to east of the Wall; the largest lit the ground; black vapor more than a zhang long issued below the Net constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, hundreds of meteors streaked southwest to east of the Wall; the brightest lit the earth; a black plume a zhang long rose below the Net.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，越州水，賜被溺民家錢有差。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiaxu: Yue prefecture flooded; money was given in graded amounts to drowned households.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, jiaxu: Yue flooded; drowned families received graded relief.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔三司、轉運司毋借常平錢谷。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: edict that the Three Departments and transport offices must not borrow Ever-Normal cash and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the Three Departments and transport commissioners were forbidden to borrow Ever-Normal funds.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸亥，罷登、萊賣金場。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day guihai: the Deng and Lai gold-selling offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, guihai: Deng and Lai gold-selling offices were closed.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申，並、代、忻州並言地震，吏民壓死者三萬二千三百六人，傷五千六百人，畜擾死者五萬余。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiashen: Bing, Dai, and Xin prefectures all reported earthquakes; officials and people crushed to death numbered thirty-two thousand three hundred six; wounded five thousand six hundred; livestock disturbed to death more than fifty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiashen: Bing, Dai, and Xin reported earthquakes—32,306 dead, 5,600 wounded, more than 50,000 livestock killed.

sentences.zh: 遣使撫存其民，賜死傷之家錢有差。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to comfort and preserve the people; money was given in graded amounts to dead and wounded households.
translations.idiomatic: Comfort envoys went out with graded payments to the dead and wounded.

sentences.zh: 是歲，滑州民蠶成被，長二丈五尺。

translations.literal: That year, a Huazhou commoner’s silkworms wove a quilt two zhang five chi long.
translations.idiomatic: That year a Huazhou farmer’s silkworms spun a quilt two zhang five chi long.

sentences.zh: 唃廝囉、龜茲、沙州來貢。

translations.literal: Gusiluo, Kucha, and Shazhou came to tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Gusiluo, Kucha, and Shazhou sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 寶元元年春正月甲辰，雷。

translations.literal: Baoyuan year one, spring, first month, day jiachen: thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyuan 1, first month, jiachen: thunder sounded.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以地震及雷發不時，詔轉運使、提舉刑獄按所部官吏。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: because of the earthquake and untimely thunder, edict that transport commissioners and judicial commissioners investigate officials in their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, earthquake and ill-timed thunder brought orders for transport and judicial commissioners to investigate local officials.

sentences.zh: 除並、代、忻州壓死民家去年秋糧。

translations.literal: Last year’s autumn grain of households crushed to death in Bing, Dai, and Xin prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Bing, Dai, and Xin families crushed in the quake had last year’s autumn tax forgiven.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，詔復日御前殿。

translations.literal: Second month, day renshen: edict to resume daily audiences in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, renshen: daily audiences in the front hall resumed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，安化蠻寇宜、融州。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Anhua barbarians raided Yi and Rong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Anhua tribes raided Yi and Rong.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌朔，王隨、陳堯佐、韓億、石中立罷，以張士遜為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士，章得象同中書門下平章事、集賢殿大學士，王鬷、李若穀並參知政事，王博文、陳執中同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuxu new moon: Wang Sui, Chen Yaozuo, Han Yi, and Shi Zhongli were removed; Zhang Shixun was made vice director of the Secretariat, associate chief councilor, and Zhaowen grand academician; Zhang Dexiang was made associate chief councilor and Jixian grand academician; Wang Zou and Li Ruogu became participating administrators; Wang Bowen and Chen Zhizhong became associate directors of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, new moon wuxu: Wang Sui, Chen Yaozuo, Han Yi, and Shi Zhongli fell; Zhang Shixun and Zhang Dexiang became chancellors; Wang Zou and Li Ruogu joined the council; Wang Bowen and Chen Zhizhong became deputy military directors.

sentences.zh: 己亥，發邵、澧、潭三州駐泊兵討安化州蠻。

translations.literal: Day jihai: garrison troops of Shao, Li, and Tan prefectures were sent to suppress the Anhua prefecture barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, garrisons from Shao, Li, and Tan marched against the Anhua tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，賜禮部奏名進士、諸科及第出身七百二十四人。

translations.literal: That month, seven hundred twenty-four jinshi and miscellaneous subjects who passed the Ministry of Rites list were granted rank.
translations.idiomatic: That month, seven hundred twenty-four men passed the palace list and received rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，王博文卒。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guiyou: Wang Bowen died.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guiyou: Wang Bowen died.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以張觀同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day yihai: Zhang Guan was made associate director of the Military Affairs Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, Zhang Guan became deputy director of the Military Affairs Bureau.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，除宜、融州夏稅。

translations.literal: Day renchen: summer tax of Yi and Rong prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Yi and Rong summer tax was waived.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day yisi: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, yisi: the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，罷舉童子。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuyin: the child-prodigy examination was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuyin: the child-prodigy exam was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，建州大水，壞民廬舍，賜死傷家錢有差，其無主者，官葬祭之。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Jian prefecture flooded, destroying people’s houses; money was given in graded amounts to dead and wounded households; those without kin, the government buried and sacrificed for them.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Jian flooded; the dead and wounded were paid; the state buried and mourned those without kin.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔天下諸州月上雨雪狀。

translations.literal: Day jiashen: edict that all prefectures monthly report rain and snow conditions.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, every prefecture was told to report monthly on rain and snow.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬戌，策制舉人。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day renxu: decree-examination candidates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, renxu: decree examinees sat their tests.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，策武舉人。

translations.literal: Day guihai: military-examination candidates were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, military examinees sat their tests.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，復淮南、江、浙、荊湖制置發運使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: the Huainan, Jiang-Zhe, and Jing-Hu supervisory transport commissioner was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingmao: the Huainan, Jiang-Zhe, and Jing-Hu transport superintendent was restored.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，熒惑犯南斗。

translations.literal: Day gengchen: Mars transgressed the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Mars crossed the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 九月戊申，詔應祀事，己受誓戒而失虔恭者，毋以赦原。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wushen: edict that in responding to sacrifices, those who after taking the vow lost reverence should not be forgiven by amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, wushen: officials who broke ritual vows before sacrifices could not be saved by amnesty.

sentences.zh: 賜宜、融州討蠻兵緡錢。

translations.literal: Cash strings were bestowed on troops suppressing barbarians in Yi and Rong prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and Rong campaign troops received cash strings.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，詔戒百官朋黨。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingyin: edict warning the hundred officials against faction.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, bingyin: officials were warned against forming factions.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己酉，王隨卒。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day jiyou: Wang Sui died.
translations.idiomatic: Year two, first month, jiyou: Wang Sui died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，安化蠻平。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Anhua barbarians were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, the Anhua tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，趙元昊表請稱帝、改元。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Zhao Yuanhao memorialized requesting to style himself emperor and change the era name.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Yuanhao asked to declare himself emperor and adopt a new era name.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，鑄皇宋通寶錢。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingwei: Great Song universal treasure coins were cast.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingwei: Great Song universal treasure cash was cast.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，閱試衛士。

translations.literal: Day yimao: the imperial guard was reviewed in examination.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the imperial guard was reviewed in drill.

sentences.zh: 戊午，賜陝西緣邊軍士緡錢。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: cash strings were bestowed on soldiers along the Shaanxi frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Shaanxi frontier troops received cash strings.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，授唃廝囉二子瞎氈、磨氈角團練使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day guihai: Gusiluo’s two sons Xiazhan and Mozhanjiao were made regiment commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guihai: Gusiluo’s sons Xiazhan and Mozhanjiao became regiment commanders.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，放宮女二百七十人。

translations.literal: Day yichou: two hundred seventy palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, two hundred seventy palace women were sent out.

sentences.zh: 壬申，免昭州運糧死蠻寇者家徭二年、賦租一年。

translations.literal: Day renshen: households of those who died transporting grain to Zhaozhou killed by barbarian raiders were exempted from corvée two years and rent one year.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, families of Zhaozhou grain carriers killed by raiders were freed from corvée two years and rent one year.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，募河東、陝西民入粟實邊。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: the people of Hedong and Shaanxi were recruited to bring grain to fill the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Hedong and Shaanxi commoners were recruited to fill frontier granaries.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，詔近臣舉方略材武之士各二人。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day guisi: edict that close ministers each recommend two men of strategy and martial talent.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, guisi: close ministers were each to name two strategists and warriors.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁皇族及諸命婦、女冠、尼等非時入內。

translations.literal: Day jihai: imperial clansmen, titled ladies, nuns, and Daoist priestesses were forbidden to enter the palace at improper times.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, clansmen, titled ladies, nuns, and priestesses were barred from the palace at odd hours.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，命近臣同三司議節省浮費。

translations.literal: Day guimao: close ministers were ordered with the Three Departments to discuss reducing extravagant spending.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, close ministers and the Three Departments were told to cut waste.

sentences.zh: 丙午，遣使體量安撫陝西、河東。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: envoys were sent to assess and comfort Shaanxi and Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, envoys went to assess and comfort Shaanxi and Hedong.

sentences.zh: 己酉，錄系囚。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬子，王德用罷，以夏守贇知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day renzi: Wang Deyong was removed; Xia Shouyun was made director of the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Wang Deyong was dismissed and Xia Shouyun took the Military Affairs Commission.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，詔省浮費，自乘輿服御及宮掖所須，宜從簡約，若吏兵祿賜，毋概行裁減。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renxu, edict: extravagant spending was to be cut; imperial carriages, clothing, and palace needs should be kept simple, but official and military salaries were not to be reduced across the board.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, renxu: waste was ordered cut—court travel, dress, and palace needs simplified—but salaries were not to be slashed indiscriminately.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔諸致仕官嘗犯贓者，毋推恩子孫。

translations.literal: Day wuchen, edict: retired officials who had once committed graft were not to extend grace to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, retired officials with a graft record could not pass favor to their sons.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，益州火，焚廬舍三千余區。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: fire at Yizhou burned more than three thousand dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, a Yizhou fire destroyed over three thousand homes.

sentences.zh: 壬午，削趙元昊官爵，除屬籍。
