translations.literal: Day renwu: Zhao Yuanhao’s rank and titles were stripped and he was removed from the imperial clan register.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Zhao Yuanhao was stripped of rank and struck from the clan register.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁巳，詔宗室遇南郊及乾元節恩，許官一子，餘五歲授官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day dingsi, edict: when the imperial clan received grace at the Southern Suburb and Qianyuan festivals, one son might be appointed to office; the rest received office at age five.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, dingsi: at Southern Suburb and Qianyuan favors, each clansman could appoint one son; others entered service at five.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以夏竦知涇州兼涇原、秦鳳路沿邊經略安撫使、涇原路馬步軍都總管，范雍兼鄜延、環慶路沿邊經略安撫使、鄜延路馬步軍都總管。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Xia Song was made prefect of Jing and concurrent frontier commissioner and army commander for Jingyuan and Qin-Feng circuits; Fan Yong was made concurrent frontier commissioner and army commander for Yan-Yan and Huanqing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Xia Song took Jing with Jingyuan–Qin-Feng frontier command; Fan Yong took Yan-Yan–Huanqing frontier command.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，以篳篥城唃廝波補本族軍主。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingmao: Gusipo of Biluo city was appointed tribal army commander of his people.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, dingmao: Biluo’s Gusipo became his tribe’s army commander.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇子生。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: a prince was born.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, a prince was born.

sentences.zh: 丙子，降三京囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: prisoners in the three capitals were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, three-capital prisoners were cut one grade; penal servants and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命輔臣報祠高禖。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: chief ministers were ordered to report the sacrifice at the High Millet.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, chief ministers were told to report the High Millet rite.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，詔河北轉運使兼都大制置營田屯田事。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin, edict: Hebei transport commissioners were also made grand commissioners of camp and garrison fields.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renyin: Hebei transport commissioners also took charge of camp and garrison fields.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，出內庫銀四萬兩易粟，振益、梓、利、夔路饑民。

translations.literal: Day yimao: forty thousand taels of silver from the inner treasury were exchanged for grain to relieve famine in Yi, Zi, Li, and Kui circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, forty thousand taels of inner-treasury silver bought grain for famine victims in four Sichuan circuits.

sentences.zh: 十月庚午，賜麟、府州及川、陝軍士緡錢。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day gengwu: strings of cash were granted to troops at Lin and Fu prefectures and in Sichuan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, gengwu: cash was granted to troops at Lin and Fu and across Sichuan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 甲申，詔兩川饑民出劍門關者勿禁。

translations.literal: Day jiashen, edict: famine refugees in the two Sichuan circuits leaving through Sword Gate Pass were not to be barred.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, Sichuan famine refugees exiting Sword Gate Pass were not to be stopped.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子朔，出內庫珠，易緡錢三十萬糴邊儲。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, new moon wuzi: pearls from the inner treasury were exchanged for three hundred thousand strings of cash to buy border grain reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, new moon wuzi: inner-treasury pearls were sold for three hundred thousand strings to fill border granaries.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，盛度、程琳罷，出御史中丞孔道輔。

translations.literal: Day dingyou: Sheng Du and Cheng Lin were removed; Censor-in-chief Kong Daofu was expelled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Sheng Du and Cheng Lin were dismissed and Censor-in-chief Kong Daofu was expelled.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以王鬷知樞密院事，宋庠參知政事。

translations.literal: Day renyin: Wang Zun was made director of the Military Affairs Commission; Song Qi became participating administrator.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, Wang Zun headed Military Affairs and Song Qi joined the council.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，詔審刑院、大理寺、刑部毋通賓客。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day gengshen, edict: the Review of Punishments, Court of Judicial Review, and Ministry of Justice were not to receive guests.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengshen: the three judicial offices were barred from entertaining guests.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔：「御史闕員，朕自擇舉。

translations.literal: Day renshen, edict: “For vacant censor posts, I shall choose appointees myself.”
translations.idiomatic: On renshen, the throne announced: “Censor vacancies I will fill myself.”

sentences.zh: 」是歲，曹、濮、單州蝗。

translations.literal: That year, Cao, Pu, and Shan prefectures suffered locust plagues.
translations.idiomatic: That year locusts struck Cao, Pu, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 康定元年春正月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Kangding year one, spring, first month, new moon bingchen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Kangding 1, new moon bingchen: a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，賜國子監學田五十頃。

translations.literal: Day renxu: fifty qing of state-academy land were granted to the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the state academy received fifty qing of school land.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇延州，執鄜延、環慶兩路副都總管劉平、鄜延副都總管石元孫。

translations.literal: That month, Yuanhao raided Yan prefecture and captured Liu Ping, vice commander of the Yan-Yan and Huanqing routes, and Shi Yuansun, vice commander of the Yan-Yan route.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao raided Yanzhou and captured route deputies Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西運使明鎬募強壯備邊。

translations.literal: Edict: Shaanxi transport commissioner Ming Hao was to recruit strong men to ready the border.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi transport Ming Hao was ordered to recruit men for the border.

sentences.zh: 二月丁亥，以夏守贇為宣徽南院使、陝西馬步軍都總管、經略安撫使。

translations.literal: Second month, day dinghai: Xia Shouyun was made southern commissioner of the Palace Attendant Service, overall commander of Shaanxi horse and foot forces, and frontier commissioner and pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, dinghai: Xia Shouyun became Xuanhui southern commissioner, Shaanxi army commander, and frontier pacifier.

sentences.zh: 詔潼關設備。

translations.literal: Edict: Tong Pass was to be put on alert.
translations.idiomatic: Tong Pass was ordered fortified.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，月、太白俱犯昴。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: the moon and Venus both trespassed the Mao constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, moon and Venus both crossed Mao.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，夏守贇兼沿邊招討使。

translations.literal: Day renchen: Xia Shouyun was also made frontier suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Xia Shouyun also became frontier suppression commissioner.

sentences.zh: 出內藏緡錢十萬賜戍邊禁兵之家。

translations.literal: One hundred thousand strings of cash from the inner treasury were granted to families of border garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-treasury cash of one hundred thousand strings went to border garrison families.

sentences.zh: 知制誥韓琦安撫陝西。

translations.literal: Drafting drafter Han Qi was sent to comfort Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Han Qi, drafting drafter, was sent to comfort Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 白氣如繩貫日。

translations.literal: White qi like a rope ran across the sun.
translations.idiomatic: White vapor like a rope stretched across the sun.

sentences.zh: 甲午，括畿內、京東西、淮南、陝西馬。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: horses were rounded up within the metropolitan circuit, eastern and western Jingdong, Huainan, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, horses were requisitioned across the capital region, Jingdong, Huainan, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔諸路轉運使、提刑訪知邊事者以聞。

translations.literal: Day bingshen, edict: circuit transport commissioners and punishment intendants were to report what they knew of border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, transport and punishment commissioners were told to report border intelligence.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔樞密院同宰臣議邊事。

translations.literal: Day dingyou, edict: the Military Affairs Commission was to discuss border affairs jointly with chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Military Affairs and the council were ordered to debate border policy.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，出內藏緡錢八十萬付陝西市糴軍儲。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: eight hundred thousand strings of cash from the inner treasury were sent to Shaanxi to buy army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, eight hundred thousand strings from the inner treasury bought grain for Shaanxi troops.

sentences.zh: 丙午，德音：釋延州、保安軍流以下罪，寇所攻掠地除今夏稅，戍兵及戰死者賜其家緡錢。

translations.literal: Day bingwu, gracious edict: convicts at Yan prefecture and Bao’an Army below exile were released; summer tax was remitted in raided districts; families of garrison troops and battle dead were given strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, a gracious edict freed Yanzhou and Bao’an exiles and below, remitted summer tax in raided lands, and paid garrison and battle-dead families.

sentences.zh: 是日改元，去尊號「寶元」字，許中外臣庶上封章言事。

translations.literal: That day the era name was changed; the honorific characters “Treasured Origin” were removed, and court and country were permitted to submit sealed memorials on public affairs.
translations.idiomatic: That day the reign title changed, “Treasured Origin” was dropped from the honorific, and sealed memorials from all ranks were welcomed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔陝西量民力，蠲所科芻糧。

translations.literal: Day dingwei, edict: Shaanxi was to gauge civilian capacity and remit levied fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Shaanxi was told to weigh civilian burdens and cancel fodder levies.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，降范雍為尚書吏部侍郎、知安州。

translations.literal: Day guichou: Fan Yong was demoted to vice minister of the Ministry of Personnel and made prefect of An prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Fan Yong was demoted to personnel vice minister and sent to Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，出內庫珠償民馬直。

translations.literal: Day jiayin: pearls from the inner treasury compensated the people for requisitioned horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, inner-treasury pearls paid citizens for seized horses.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，詔大臣條陝西攻守策。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen, edict: chief ministers were to set out Shaanxi attack-and-defense plans.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, bingchen: ministers were ordered to draft Shaanxi offensive and defensive plans.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，命韓琦治陝西城池。

translations.literal: Day guihai: Han Qi was ordered to repair Shaanxi city walls and forts.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, Han Qi was told to repair Shaanxi defenses.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，閱虎翼軍習戰。

translations.literal: Day yichou: the Tiger Wing army’s battle drills were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, the Tiger Wing army’s drills were inspected.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔延州錄戰沒軍士子孫，月給糧。

translations.literal: Day xinwei, edict: Yan prefecture was to register descendants of soldiers killed in battle and grant them monthly grain.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Yanzhou was told to list battle-dead soldiers’ heirs and pay them monthly grain.

sentences.zh: 丙子，大風，晝暝，是夜有黑氣長數丈，見東南。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: great wind; daylight darkened; that night black qi several zhang long appeared in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, fierce wind darkened the day; that night a black vapor yards long rose in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，罷大宴。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the great banquet was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the great court banquet was called off.

sentences.zh: 詔中外言闕政。

translations.literal: Edict: court and country were to speak on governmental shortcomings.
translations.idiomatic: Court and realm were invited to report policy failures.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王鬷、陳執中、張觀罷，以晏殊、宋綬知樞密院事，王貽永同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Wang Zun, Chen Zhizhong, and Zhang Guan were removed; Yan Shu and Song Shou were made directors of the Military Affairs Commission; Wang Yiyong was made associate director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Wang Zun, Chen Zhizhong, and Zhang Guan were dismissed; Yan Shu and Song Shou headed Military Affairs with Wang Yiyong as associate.

sentences.zh: 詔按察官舉才堪將帥者。

translations.literal: Edict: investigation commissioners were to recommend men fit for generalship.
translations.idiomatic: Investigation commissioners were told to nominate men fit to command armies.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔參知政事同議邊事。

translations.literal: Day gengchen, edict: participating administrators were jointly to discuss border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, participating administrators were ordered to debate border policy together.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，德音：降天下囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day xinsi, gracious edict: prisoners empire-wide were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, a gracious edict cut all sentences one grade and freed penal servants and below.

sentences.zh: 賜京師、河北、陝西、河東諸軍緡錢，蠲陝西夏稅十之二，減河東所科粟。

translations.literal: Strings of cash were granted to armies in the capital, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong; two-tenths of Shaanxi summer tax was remitted; grain levies in Hedong were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Troops in the capital, Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong received cash; Shaanxi summer tax was cut twenty percent and Hedong grain levies eased.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，省陝西沿邊堡砦。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day bingxu: Shaanxi border forts and stockades were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingxu: Shaanxi border forts were thinned.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔諸戍邊軍月遣內侍存問其家，病致醫藥，死為斂葬之。

translations.literal: Day guisi, edict: each month inner eunuchs were to inquire after families of troops garrisoning the border; the sick were to receive medicine and the dead burial.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, monthly eunuch visits were ordered for border garrison families—with medicine for the sick and burial for the dead.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣使籍陝西強壯軍。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: envoys were sent to register strong men for the Shaanxi army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, envoys enrolled Shaanxi men for the army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，契丹國母復遣使來賀乾元節。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Khitan emperor’s mother again sent envoys to congratulate the Qianyuan festival.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Khitan empress dowager again sent Qianyuan festival envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，增補河北強壯軍。

translations.literal: Day yisi: the Hebei strong-man army was supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Hebei’s strong-man levies were reinforced.

sentences.zh: 丙午，鄜延路兵馬都監黃德和坐棄軍要斬。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: Huang Dehe, army supervisor of the Yan-Yan route, was executed for abandoning a vital post.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, Yan-Yan army supervisor Huang Dehe was executed for abandoning a key post.

sentences.zh: 丁未，贈劉平、石元孫官，錄其子孫。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun were given posthumous offices; their descendants were registered.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Liu Ping and Shi Yuansun received posthumous rank and their heirs were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，築延州金明栲栳砦。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: the Jinming Kaolao stockade at Yan prefecture was built.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Yanzhou’s Jinming Kaolao stockade was raised.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅朔，詔前殿奏事毋過五班，餘對後殿。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon jiayin, edict: audiences reporting in the front hall were not to exceed five shifts; the rest were received in the rear hall.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon jiayin: front-hall audiences were capped at five shifts; others met in the rear hall.

sentences.zh: 命大官賜食。

translations.literal: The Grand Steward was ordered to grant food.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Steward was told to provide meals.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，張士遜致事，呂夷簡為門下侍郎、同中書門下平章事、昭文館大學士。

translations.literal: Day renxu: Zhang Shisun retired; Lü Yijian was made vice director of the Gate Department, co-director of the Secretariat-Chancellery, and grand academician of the Zhaowen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, Zhang Shisun retired; Lü Yijian became Gate vice director, co-chancellor, and Zhaowen grand academician.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔夏守贇進屯鄜州。

translations.literal: Day guiyou, edict: Xia Shouyun was to advance and encamp at Yan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Xia Shouyun was ordered forward to camp at Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以夏竦為陝西馬步軍都總管兼招討使。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Xia Song was made overall commander of Shaanxi horse and foot forces and concurrent suppression commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Xia Song took Shaanxi army command and frontier suppression duty.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊陷塞門砦，兵馬監押王繼元死之，又陷安遠砦。

translations.literal: That month, Yuanhao took Saimen stockade; army supervisor Wang Jiyuan died; he also took Anyuan stockade.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao seized Saimen stockade—supervisor Wang Jiyuan was killed—and then took Anyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月丙戌，詔假日御崇政殿視事如前殿。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingxu, edict: on holidays the emperor was to hold court at Chongzheng Hall as in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingxu: holidays, court would sit in Chongzheng Hall as in the main hall.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以夏守贇同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Xia Shouyun was made associate director of the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Xia Shouyun became associate Military Affairs director.

sentences.zh: 甲午，降三京囚罪一等，徒以下釋之。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: prisoners in the three capitals were reduced one degree; those below penal servitude were released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, three-capital prisoners were cut one grade; penal servants and below were freed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，南京鴻慶宮神御殿火。

translations.literal: Day yiwei: the Spirit Hall of Hongqing Palace in the Southern Capital burned.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei, the Southern Capital’s Hongqing Spirit Hall burned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣使體量安撫京東、西。

translations.literal: Day renyin: envoys were sent to assess and comfort eastern and western Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, envoys went to assess and comfort eastern and western Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，增置陝西、河北、河東、京東西弓手。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: bowmen were added in Shaanxi, Hebei, Hedong, and eastern and western Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, archer levies were expanded across Shaanxi, Hebei, Hedong, and Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，遣使以討元昊告契丹。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day yichou: envoys were sent to inform the Khitan of the campaign against Yuanhao.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yichou: envoys told the Khitan of the war on Yuanhao.

sentences.zh: 庚午，閱諸軍習戰。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: the armies’ battle drills were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, army battle drills were inspected.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，皇子昕為忠正軍節度使，封壽國公。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: Prince Xin was made military commissioner of the Zhongzheng army and enfeoffed Duke of Shou State.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Prince Xin became Zhongzheng commissioner and Duke of Shou State.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，禁以金箔飾佛像。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: gilding Buddha images with gold foil was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuxu: gold foil on Buddha images was banned.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣尚書屯田員外郎劉渙使邈川。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Ministerial Field Services outer-section member Liu Huan was sent as envoy to Miaochuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liu Huan of the Field Service was sent to Miaochuan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，夏守贇罷，以杜衍同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wushen: Xia Shouyun was removed; Du Yan was made associate director of the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Xia Shouyun left Military Affairs and Du Yan became associate director.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔范仲淹、葛懷敏領兵驅逐塞門等砦蕃騎出境，仍募弓箭手，給地居之。

translations.literal: Day xinhai, edict: Fan Zhongyan and Ge Huaimin were to lead troops to drive Tibetan cavalry from Saimen and other stockades beyond the border, and archers were to be recruited and given land to settle.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Fan Zhongyan and Ge Huaimin were told to expel Tibetan riders from Saimen forts and settle recruited archers on frontier land.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，滑州河溢。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiayin: the Yellow River overflowed at Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiayin: the Yellow River flooded Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李若穀罷，以宋綬、晁宗愨參知政事，鄭戩同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Li Ruogu was removed; Song Shou and Chao Zongque became participating administrators; Zheng Yan was made associate director of the Military Affairs Commission.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Li Ruogu was dismissed; Song Shou and Chao Zongque joined the council; Zheng Yan became associate Military Affairs director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以晏殊為樞密使，王貽永、杜衍、鄭戩並樞密副使。

translations.literal: Day wuchen: Yan Shu was made military affairs commissioner; Wang Yiyong, Du Yan, and Zheng Yan were all made vice commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Yan Shu headed Military Affairs; Wang Yiyong, Du Yan, and Zheng Yan became vice commissioners.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔使臣、諸班、諸軍有武藝者自陳。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu, edict: envoys, guard shifts, and army units with martial skill were to report themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, skilled envoys, guards, and soldiers were told to come forward.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，閱諸軍習戰。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: the armies’ battle drills were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, army battle drills were inspected.

sentences.zh: 是月，元昊寇三川砦，都巡檢楊保吉死之。

translations.literal: That month, Yuanhao raided Sanchuan stockade; chief inspector Yang Baoji died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Yuanhao hit Sanchuan stockade and inspector Yang Baoji was killed.

sentences.zh: 又圍師子、定川堡，戰士死者五千余人，遂陷乾溝、乾河、趙福三堡。

translations.literal: He also besieged Shizi and Dingchuan forts; more than five thousand fighters died, and he then took the three forts of Qiangou, Qianhe, and Zhaofu.
translations.idiomatic: He besieged Shizi and Dingchuan—five thousand dead—and seized Qiangou, Qianhe, and Zhaofu.

sentences.zh: 環慶路兵馬副都總管任福破白豹城。

translations.literal: Ren Fu, vice overall commander of the Huanqing route forces, took Baobao city.
translations.idiomatic: Huanqing deputy Ren Fu captured Baobao city.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙未，制銅符、木契、傳信牌。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yiwei: bronze tally tokens, wooden contracts, and signal plaques were made.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, yiwei: bronze tallies, wooden contracts, and signal plaques were issued.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，錄方略士六十一人，授官有差。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: sixty-one strategists were registered and given offices in varying grades.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, sixty-one strategists were enrolled and appointed at varied ranks.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，有大星流西南，聲如雷者三。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day renxu: a great star streaked southwest; three thunder-like sounds were heard.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, renxu: a great star shot southwest amid three thunderclaps.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，出內藏庫絹一百萬助糴軍儲。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day guiwei: one million bolts of silk from the inner treasury were issued to help buy army grain.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, guiwei: one million bolts of inner-treasury silk bought army grain.

sentences.zh: 詔南京祠大火。

translations.literal: Edict: the Southern Capital was to sacrifice to the Great Fire.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Capital was ordered to sacrifice to the Great Fire star.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔以常平緡錢助糴軍儲。

translations.literal: Day bingxu, edict: Ever-Normal strings of cash were to help buy army grain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, Ever-Normal treasury cash was earmarked for army grain.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，宋綬卒。

translations.literal: Day guimao: Song Shou died.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Song Shou died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，鑄當十錢權助邊費。

translations.literal: Day wushen: ten-cash coins were cast to help border expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, ten-cash coins were minted to fund the frontier.
